witness.Young_hilbert_space_proof: Nonnegative squared norm of sqrt(delta)*U-V/sqrt(delta) yields (1+delta)||U||^2+(1+1/delta)||V||^2.
witness.continuous_ideal_coordinate_unit_L2_theo: Independent continuous U,V within each pair give integral(-2logU)=2 and integral cos^2(2piV+phi)=1/2, so E Zi^2=1 for either branch; no cross-coordinate/native-error independence needed.
